about: Synthetic speed-run personas (invented people, no real patient data). Weeks are calendar weeks of the run (week 1 starts Monday 2026-01-05). A week not listed does every planned session with an ordinary check-in. Session fields: feel too_easy|right|too_hard, energy low|ok|good, scale (with low energy), sore [areas] + soreness some|a_lot, areas [work-around chips], pain area. An empty week [] is a gap; after week 9 of a cycle an empty week means she has not started her next cycle yet. events: setup / dumbbells changes, used from her next cycle.

personas.name: Dana
personas.story: Brand new to lifting, achy knees on stairs, big-box gym. Very consistent.

personas.name: Maria
personas.story: Trains at home with bands and light dumbbells, stiff low back, busy: 2 days of 30 minutes, often only one.

personas.name: Jen
personas.story: Lifted regularly before. Barbell gym, 4 days of 60 minutes. Runs down in weeks 2 to 3.

personas.name: Carol
personas.story: 63, never lifted, dumbbells and a bench at home. Provider said no floor work and no lying flat.

personas.name: Lisa
personas.story: Busy job with travel: misses week 5, a patchy week 8, then five weeks away in cycle 2.

personas.name: Ruth
personas.story: 72, light dumbbells and bands at home, a touchy shoulder, two short sessions a week.

personas.name: Mike
personas.story: Male patient, provider said no overhead pressing, touchy shoulder. Finds some weeks too easy.

personas.name: Tanya
personas.story: Starts at home, joins a gym in week 8, takes two weeks to do her first cycle review.

personas.name: Beth
personas.story: Knee pain flares in weeks 3 to 4, sore a lot after week 2, then settles.

personas.name: Gina
personas.story: Asks for 4 days in Foundations (gets 3), picks 4 at her review. Two bad weeks early, a hard patch in cycle 2.
